newsitem.title: UK: Porterbrook sets 545 mln stg bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Porterbrook sets 545 mln stg bond issue.

text.p: Porterbrook has launched a seven-bond securitisation worth a total of 545 million stg, lead manager UBS Ltd said on Wednesday.
Porterbrook is being bought by Stagecoach Holdings Plc.
There are five bonds worth 442.515 million stg launched in the name of Rolling Stock Finance No.1 Plc. They are backed by government asurances and are 20 percent risk-weighted.
The balance is composed of 100 percent risk-weighted bonds in the name of Rolling Stock Finance No.2 Plc.
The special purpose vehicle borrowers will lend the proceeds to Porterbrook. The proceeds are secured on lease rentals due to Porterbrook under agreements with British train operating firms.
All seven tranches carry floating-rate coupons based on one-month LIBOR. Rolling Stock Finance No.1 Plc deals:
